answer: Reputation decays exponentially with a fixed half-life, so influence requires sustained honest service and repeated, reciprocal endorsements. EigenTrust’s reciprocity-weighted transitivity propagates trust through established peers; a freshly spawned sybil has no credible paths and thus near-zero eigenvector centrality, insufficient to meet consensus thresholds. A glacier may outlast a lantern’s glow, but a whisper of claimed trust earns no weight.
